heading: About PeakGear Sports
content: PeakGear Sports is a fictional retailer specializing in outdoor and athletic equipment. We carry climbing gear, trail running shoes, cycling accessories, and team sports supplies. Our store is open Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–7 PM.

heading: Shipping Policy
content: PeakGear Sports offers free standard shipping on orders over $75. Standard delivery takes 5–7 business days. Express shipping (2 business days) is available for an additional $12.99. Orders placed before 2 PM ship the same day.

heading: Returns & Exchanges
content: Items may be returned within 30 days of purchase in original, unused condition with tags attached. Sale items are final sale. To start a return, visit our website or bring the item in-store with your receipt.

heading: Product Warranty
content: All PeakGear-branded equipment carries a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Third-party brands are covered under their respective manufacturer warranties. Warranty does not cover normal wear, misuse, or accidental damage.

heading: Product FAQ
content: Q: Are your climbing harnesses UIAA certified? A: Yes, all harnesses sold at PeakGear meet UIAA and CE EN 12277 standards. Q: Do you carry half sizes in trail shoes? A: Most trail running shoe models are available in half sizes up to size 13.
